growth_signal.value: 20,000 downloads and 113,000+ AI health conversations; valuation tripled in a year.

entry.idea: Women's health is often under-studied and hard to get answers about, so Ovum gives women an AI health app they can talk to.
entry.lesson: Build a product people use daily, and the data it gathers becomes a second asset nobody else has.
entry.name: Ovum

growth.reason: Downloads and chats are growing and valuation tripled, but the numbers are small and mostly from the company.

market.reason: Half the world's people could use better women's health tools.

tech.reason: An AI app on common tools is copyable, though the growing dataset adds some edge.

Women's health startup Ovum lands $4 million seed funding

entry.twist: Every conversation builds a long-running women's health dataset, and the founder is a doctor.
entry.who_pays: Investors fund it today; the paying customers would be app users and health partners.
entry.why_now: People now trust AI chat for health questions, and investors are backing women's health.
